_comment: Pre-existing swallowed supabase reads, recorded at adoption of scripts/check_read_errors_not_swallowed.py (ADR 0067). ADOPTION IS THE MERGE OF THAT GUARD, not the day this file was first written: code that reached main before the guard did is pre-existing by definition, and rows for it may be added while this branch is still open. AFTER the guard is on main this list ONLY SHRINKS -- a key absent from the tree fails the build, and a new finding must be fixed or allowlisted with a written reason in the guard, never appended here. Two rows were added on 2026-09-02 under the first rule (procurement.service.ts from PR #240, and SeatingDensityPanel.tsx which is a detector false match from an ASI statement boundary, not a real swallowed read); six were retired the same day because concurrent sessions fixed them. Lowered 2026-09-12 (ADR 0141): releaseOrderShadowStock's restaurant_inventory read now binds its error and refuses, so procurement.service.ts::restaurant_inventory::inv drops 2 -> 1 and the rows now sum to 189. Lowered 2026-09-16 (ADR 0149 row 26): getDigestPref now binds its error and throws, because the digest sender reads that row, so recommendation-actions.service.ts::recommendation_digest_prefs::data is retired and the rows sum to 188 across 41 files. Lowered 2026-09-18 (cellar fix pass, ADR 0160 sec110 item 3(c)): fetchAnalytics's inventory_analytics read now checks `error` and reports `analyticsReadable: false` rather than silently returning an empty map, so inventory.service.ts::inventory_analytics::data drops 1 -> 0. total_sites re-measured at that merge as the real sum of the rows, 176 across 41 files: the 188 recorded before it had drifted from its own rows, which summed to 177. Lowered 2026-09-21 (ADR 0193, menu versions): importMenu no longer reuses the house's one active menu, so upsertMenu and its unchecked restaurant_menus read are deleted; menus.service.ts::restaurant_menus::existing is retired and the rows sum to 175 across 41 files. Lowered 2026-09-21 (ADR 0193, last-call review): addToInventory now binds the error on its restaurant_inventory read and reports the line failed, because make-current decides the blank-price flag from that read; menus.service.ts::restaurant_inventory::existing is retired and the rows sum to 174 across 41 files. Lowered 2026-09-23 (#434 onto #430): the merge had kept two already-fixed rows (integrations-oauth.service.ts::integration_oauth_connections::data from #430's consent rewrite; inventory.service.ts::inventory_analytics::data from the 2026-09-18 cellar fix). Both actual=0; retired so the rows sum to 170. Lowered 2026-09-23 (#455 after #414): auth.service.ts::users::existing actual=0 after account-only signup; retired so the rows sum to 168. Lowered 2026-09-25 (ADR 0164, sessions follow membership, fix/sessions-follow-membership-r6): switchRestaurant lost its organisation fallback (auth.service.ts organization_members::orgMemberships, restaurants::ownRestaurant) and its own access read (user_restaurant_access::uraAccess); generateTokens now binds its membership read's error and answers 503 (user_restaurant_access::membership); createLocation no longer reads organizations::ownedOrg on one path (2 -> 1). Rows sum to 163 across 38 files, measured by the guard on this tree; total_files re-counted as the distinct files with a non-zero row (it read 41 on main, where the real count was already 38).  Lowered 2026-09-27 (ADR 0111, PR #438): the recurrence-rule read the calendar feed used now lives in calendar-links.service.ts readRules(), which binds its error and throws FeedUnavailableError, so calendar.service.ts::calendar_recurrence_rules::rules is retired (1 -> 0). total_sites re-measured as the real sum of the rows, 160 across 38 files: main recorded 163 while its own rows summed to 161, the same drift the 2026-09-18 lowering corrected. Lowered 2026-09-27 (#440 merged onto origin/main 4b2a8e389, combining ADR 0215's team-pay fix, which retired schedule.service.ts::team_members::m, with #438): re-measured by the guard on the merged tree, 1789 files scanned, 159 sites, 159 baselined, 38 files. This list only shrinks.
